nodes.label: Six Therapeutic Modules system
nodes.rationale: Activities are grouped into 6 therapeutic areas so the landing stays navigable (4-6 options rule) while covering coordination, autonomy, memory, reasoning, language and emotions; an activity may serve more than one area but appears once, under its primary module.

nodes.label: Hidden routes pattern (ajustes/, equipo/, presentacion/)
nodes.rationale: Pages for adults (family/staff/AI agent) that manage the device are deliberately never linked from site/index.html or activities, carry noindex/nofollow, and are the only pages allowed clinical/device-administration language — kept separate so the end-user interface stays free of clinical vocabulary and administrative complexity.

nodes.label: Multi-file per-locale i18n system (strings.<locale>.js)
nodes.rationale: Replaced a single strings.js with {es:{},en:{}} because it downloaded both languages to every client; splitting per locale halves the payload, lets translators edit only their language, produces clean diffs, and scales to new languages without touching existing files.

nodes.label: Local progress/storage contract (estrellas, completado, localStorage only)
nodes.rationale: Privacy-by-default: only `estrellas` (integer) and `completado` (finished levels) plus a few explicit optional fields are ever stored; failures, time spent, attempt counts, comparisons and identifiable profiles are never saved, and progress never leaves the device or syncs to the cloud.
nodes.norm_label: local progress/storage contract (estrellas, completado, localstorage only)

nodes.label: 13 mandatory accessibility rules for new activities
nodes.rationale: Easy Reading, 64px touch targets, WCAG AA contrast, audio on all key text, no timers/negative scoring, positive reinforcement, reduced-motion support, full keyboard nav, ARIA, max 4-6 options, 3-option quizzes, Socratic hints, and one-variable-per-level progression — together they guarantee the product can be used autonomously by people with intellectual disability.
nodes.norm_label: 13 mandatory accessibility rules for new activities

nodes.label: No-pressure / error-never-punishes principle
nodes.rationale: No stars or progress are ever subtracted, failure only triggers an encouragement message (never 'incorrect'), retries are unlimited, and Socratic hints precede answers — because the product exists so a person with intellectual disability can practice without fear of visible failure.

nodes.label: PWA update notice (controllerchange detection)
nodes.rationale: Since the service worker calls skipWaiting()+clients.claim() without asking, the landing listens for navigator.serviceWorker.oncontrollerchange and only shows the update banner if a previous controller already existed, distinguishing first install from a real update.
